errors.error_description: A sequential always block triggers on posedge clk, negedge rst_n, and also posedge enable, mixing an asynchronous non-reset control with the clocked process.
A deeply nested if-else chain is used to compute an index instead of a structured case/priority approach, creating long combinational paths and poor synthesis quality.
The internal net decode_a is driven by two continuous assignments, creating multiple active drivers and potential bus contention.
